content.subject: Randomized trials and systematic overviews of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and related agents
key_points: Multiple randomized trials and meta-analyses of ACE inhibitors (ramipril, enalapril, lisinopril, captopril) and angiotensin receptor blocker (valsartan) in high-risk cardiovascular patients, acute myocardial infarction, and chronic heart failure are cited.
Outcomes addressed across cited studies include cardiovascular events, mortality, morbidity, left ventricular dysfunction, heart failure prognosis, and survival.
Several landmark trials and reviews are included (e.g., HOPE investigators, ACE Inhibitor Myocardial Infarction Collaborative Group, CONSENSUS, comparative dose studies, enalapril survival studies).
